column1: # SpellsCustomAttribute.csv: put it in the WXL folder beside the client executable (WXL\SpellsCustomAttribute.csv; the path
# can be changed with [SpellArea] CustomAttributeFile). Export of the server's spell custom attribute column: spell id
# attribute mask (decimal or 0x hex). See SpellArea.md. Only two bits matter here:
#   2 = CONE_BACK  the cone is behind the caster (a tail sweep)
#   4 = CONE_LINE  the cone is a line in front of the caster
